sources.title: Agent Hijacks: How Conversation History Poisoning Can Turn AI Agents ...
sources.snippet: New research reveals how agentic AI harnesses can be hijacked, turning a workstation into an autonomous attacker. Using conversation history poisoning, researchers convinced a frontier model it was an authorized red teamer, exposing how common AI workflows may be weaponized through a single package install.
